title: Ragged per-graph Python loops and separate backward passes in a crystal GNN energy/force evaluator
authoring_note: SciML graph/materials task shaped after FAIRChem radius-graph + PBC energy/force evaluation. Baseline loops over graphs and calls backward once per graph; the reference fix concatenates the ragged batch into a single batched graph and performs one batched backward. Plain torch only (no PyG). Calibrated on the authoring host; range is updated to measured reality.
author: batch-SciML-A prototype agent
